389: fn rewrite_component_item(item: SpecItem, component: &Component) -> SpecItem {
390:     let alias = &component.alias;
391:     match item {
392:         SpecItem::Const { name, value } => SpecItem::Const {
393:             name: prefix(alias, &name),
394:             value: Box::new(rewrite_expr(*value, component, &HashSet::new())),
395:         },
396:         SpecItem::Type {
397:             name,
398:             lo,
399:             hi,
400:             symmetric,
401:         } => SpecItem::Type {
402:             name: prefix(alias, &name),
403:             lo: Box::new(rewrite_expr(*lo, component, &HashSet::new())),
404:             hi: Box::new(rewrite_expr(*hi, component, &HashSet::new())),
405:             symmetric,
406:         },
407:         SpecItem::Enum {
408:             name,
409:             members,
410:             member_spans,
411:             symmetric,
412:         } => SpecItem::Enum {
413:             name: prefix(alias, &name),
414:             members,
415:             member_spans,
416:             symmetric,
417:         },
418:         SpecItem::Struct { name, fields, span } => SpecItem::Struct {
419:             name: prefix(alias, &name),
420:             span,
421:             fields: fields
422:                 .into_iter()
423:                 .map(|(name, ty)| (name, rewrite_type(ty, component)))
424:                 .collect(),
425:         },
426:         SpecItem::State(fields) => SpecItem::State(
427:             fields
428:                 .into_iter()
429:                 .map(|field| fsl_syntax::StateField {
430:                     name: prefix(alias, &field.name),
431:                     ty: rewrite_type(field.ty, component),
432:                     initializer: field
433:                         .initializer
434:                         .map(|expr| rewrite_expr(expr, component, &HashSet::new())),
435:                     span: field.span,
436:                     initializer_span: field.initializer_span,
437:                 })
438:                 .collect(),
439:         ),
440:         SpecItem::Init {
441:             statements,
442:             meta,
443:             annotations,
444:         } => SpecItem::Init {
445:             statements: rewrite_statements(statements, component, &HashSet::new()),
446:             meta,
447:             annotations,
448:         },
449:         SpecItem::Action {
450:             name,
451:             params,
452:             items,
453:             span,
454:             fair,
455:             meta,
456:             sync,
457:             annotations,
458:         } => {
459:             let params = params
460:                 .into_iter()
461:                 .map(|param| rewrite_param(param, component))
462:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
463:             let bound = params
464:                 .iter()

466:                     Param::Typed(name, _) | Param::Range(name, _, _) => name.clone(),
467:                 })
468:                 .collect();

470:                 name: prefix(alias, &name),
471:                 params,
472:                 items: rewrite_action_items(items, component, &bound),
473:                 span,
474:                 fair,
475:                 meta,
476:                 sync,
477:                 annotations,
478:             }
479:         }
480:         SpecItem::Invariant {
481:             name,

484:             meta,
